items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I was working with Herman Chittison

ctx.x: Yeah, well the material that I did with Ellis was, - to be frank, during the time that I was in the Le Ruban Bleu this is when I began to develop a style, an approach to pop music, to standards. And then of course, during the time I was at the Le Ruban Bleu I was working with Herman Chittison, you know, great piano player and accompanist. And it gave me a lot of scope there, and of course the Le Ruban Bleu was a very good Club to work in. It was a small, intimate club, and that I was working with a trio therefore…
